structural_delta: Root order is stage_id, entries, coverage_receipt, coverage_decision.
Entry-type field combinations are enforced by both strict schema and character constraint.
Only UNRESOLVED_SCOPE may carry unresolved candidate semantic axes.
INDETERMINATE requires an unresolved entry and unresolved_scope_present true.
COMPLETE requires all review receipts true, no unresolved entry, and unresolved_scope_present false.
prompt_delta: Defines the factual-return test without exposing expected case labels.
Requires integrated creative constructions to remain units unless subspans carry independent propositions.
Preserves exhaustive embedded, presupposed, entailed, and necessarily implied proposition review.
Requires story-local semantic descriptions rather than generic commitment placeholders.
preserved_boundaries: No FSEM or admission decision in Stage P
No repair, retry, selection, or replacement
bounded_next_step_if_authorized: Perform a zero-inference real-tokenizer trie/profile check against the frozen local tokenizer, without loading model weights. If compatible, bind a one-shot evaluation runner and stop again before inference.
